lineage.description: IDP site locations and population counts were collected through the Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) methodology, a standardized IOM approach for tracking internally displaced populations. Data was compiled collaboratively by DoDMA, IOM, and the Shelter Cluster for the Southern Region of Malawi as of 6 March 2015, and delivered as georeferenced point data (KMZ format) representing displacement sites and associated IDP populations.
